verdict.rationale: Working Copy has a 'Repository Agent' AI assistant that can be conversed with to browse files, search content, read/modify files, commit, pull and push, directly enabling natural-language operation, and separately offers AI-generated commit messages. However, this is documented only via a single vendor manual line with no independent/community validation of its reliability or scope, and no API/automation-first architecture (llms.txt, OpenAPI) supports broader agentic use.
